name: progress
title: Progress
description: Uploads, imports, and other work with a measurable end.

motionProfile.reason: A local progress root owns its entrance, content-driven height and per-part paint; the fill retargets inside the caller's fixed track, the formatted readout settles when the fill still has to travel, and the status pulse is one theme-clock opacity owner.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Progress owns one opacity entrance on its own root at the already-correct fill and value, plus the determinate fill retarget on its indicator; a presenting parent, a hidden host or an unusable control keeps native paint.

data.transition/continuous.reason: The indicator owns one theme-clock opacity pulse only while the primitive reports indeterminate and the host is visible; reduced and none release it and keep the static fill.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The track owns its background set and the label and value each own their foreground set; an unverified caller palette, focus or invalid paint settles that owner immediately.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The root shell owns one measured content height for the label/value flow; the track keeps the caller width and a caller-fixed or clipped box keeps native layout.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A plain ProgressLabel string replaces only changed runs; unchanged graphemes keep their identity and rich children pass through untouched.

number.roll/reels.reason: The formatted determinate readout and a direct numeric label each roll their own changed places; a fill that still has to travel settles that revision's readout immediately.
